summary.content:
Today's selection covers 79 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI slows down training after its AI carried out hack
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Cl0p Ransomware Group Names Over 40 Victims of PTC Windchill Campaign
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
